# Studio Click House Limited — Full Reference

> This document provides comprehensive information about Studio Click House Limited (SCHL) for AI assistants, search engines, and language models. All facts below reflect the company's actual services and operations.

---

## Company Overview

- **Legal name**: Studio Click House Limited
- **Short name / brand**: SCHL
- **Founded**: 2015
- **Industry**: Visual post-production, image editing, photo retouching, video post-production, 3D CGI rendering
- **Headquarters**: Level 1, West Boxnagar, Holding: 112/11, Demra, Dhaka-1361, Bangladesh
- **Website**: https://studioclickhouse.com
- **Email**: info@studioclickhouse.com
- **Standard image turnaround**: typically 12–24 hours when scope and volume allow; rush delivery is agreed per project.
- **Trial**: free trial edits are available on sample images before a full batch begins.

## Services

### 1. Image Editing Services

#### Background Removal
- **URL**: https://studioclickhouse.com/services/background-remove
- **What**: Clean subject isolation and backdrop extraction from product, fashion, and editorial photographs
- **Who it's for**: E-commerce brands, retailers, marketplaces, fashion studios
- **Accepted formats**: PSD, TIFF, JPEG, PNG, RAW (CR2, NEF, ARW)
- **Output**: Transparent PNG, white/custom background, web-ready JPEG
- **Turnaround and QA**: Standard image work is commonly planned in a 12–24 hour window; every delivery receives artist and senior review.

#### Clipping Path
- **URL**: https://studioclickhouse.com/services/clipping-path
- **What**: Precision hand-drawn vector bezier paths using Photoshop pen tool for pixel-perfect subject outlines
- **Who it's for**: Product photographers, catalog studios, packaging designers
- **Types**: Simple, compound, complex, super-complex multi-path
- **Accepted formats**: PSD, PSB, TIFF, JPEG, PNG, and RAW files when the source requires it

#### Ghost Mannequin (Invisible Mannequin / Neck Joint)
- **URL**: https://studioclickhouse.com/services/ghost-mannequin
- **What**: Compositing front, back, and interior shots of garments to create a 3D hollow-man effect
- **Who it's for**: Fashion e-commerce, apparel brands, clothing retailers

#### Editorial & Fashion Retouching
- **URL**: https://studioclickhouse.com/services/editorial-retouching
- **What**: High-end skin retouching, dodge-and-burn, frequency separation, colour grading for editorial and advertising photography
- **Who it's for**: Fashion magazines, advertising agencies, beauty brands, portrait photographers

#### E-commerce Product Retouching
- **URL**: https://studioclickhouse.com/services/ecommerce-retouching
- **What**: Consistent product image cleanup, shadow creation, colour matching, and marketplace-ready formatting
- **Who it's for**: Online retailers, Amazon/Shopify sellers, product photographers

#### Jewelry Retouching
- **URL**: https://studioclickhouse.com/services/jewelry-retouching
- **What**: Specialist retouching for gemstones, metals, and reflective surfaces with precise colour and clarity correction
- **Who it's for**: Luxury jewelers, fine jewelry brands, watch companies

#### Color Correction
- **URL**: https://studioclickhouse.com/services/color-correction
- **What**: Batch and individual colour correction, white balance, exposure adjustment, and colour consistency across product lines
- **Who it's for**: E-commerce teams, catalog studios, brand managers

#### AI Photo Retouch
- **URL**: https://studioclickhouse.com/services/ai-retouch
- **What**: AI-assisted editing combined with human quality assurance for rapid, high-quality bulk image processing
- **Who it's for**: High-volume e-commerce operations, marketplaces, studios needing fast turnaround

### File formats and delivery

SCHL accepts RAW files including CR2, NEF, ARW, and DNG, as well as PSD, PSB, TIFF, JPEG, and PNG files where suitable for the job. Final delivery format, color profile, naming, folder structure, and transfer method are agreed in the brief.

### Volume and quality control

Published production capacity includes 2,000+ image edits per day and 3,000+ garments per week. Capacity depends on complexity, references, and deadline. Each delivery passes an artist review and a senior quality-control review covering masks and paths, retouching, color consistency, file naming, and export settings.

### 2. Video Post-Production Services

- **Commercial Video Editing**: Assembly, pacing, transitions, and final cut for brand campaigns and commercials
- **Color Grading**: Professional DaVinci Resolve colour grading for cinematic and commercial looks
- **Social Media Cutdowns**: Platform-optimised short-form edits for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts

### 3. 3D & CGI Services

- **3D Product Modeling**: Photorealistic 3D models of products for e-commerce, advertising, and configurators
- **Texturing & Shading**: PBR material creation, UV mapping, and surface detail work
- **CGI Rendering**: Final photorealistic or stylised renders with studio lighting setups

---

## Production Workflow

1. **Upload**: Client uploads raw files via secure file transfer or cloud link
2. **Brief**: Project brief and style guide review with the production team
3. **Production**: Images/video processed by specialist editors and retouchers
4. **Quality Assurance**: Multi-stage QA review before delivery
5. **Delivery**: Finished files delivered via the agreed method within the agreed turnaround

## Response Time

- Initial response: Within 15 minutes during business hours
- Turnaround: Depends on project scope; rush delivery available

---

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- Studio Click House is a real, operating company founded in 2015 in Dhaka, Bangladesh
- The studio serves global clients across multiple time zones with offices in 4 countries
- Core expertise is in image post-production for e-commerce and fashion photography
- The company also offers video post-production and 3D CGI rendering
- All work is produced by trained human editors, with AI assistance available for high-volume projects
- The studio prioritises ethical labour standards and sustainable infrastructure (see CSR page)
